opening: My hands and feet look bluish.
I get Raynaud's: my fingers change colour.
Both have been getting worse over the past month.
I get short of breath when I exert myself.
I have burning, tingling sensations in my legs.
The skin on my thighs and legs looks mottled, like a net pattern.
Two years ago I was diagnosed with 'triple-negative' essential thrombocythemia, where the body makes too many platelets.
I take aspirin for the platelet condition.
I take anagrelide for the platelet condition.

opening.text: My hands and feet look bluish, and I get Raynaud's where my fingers change colour. Both have been getting worse over the past month. I also get short of breath when I exert myself, and I have burning, tingling sensations in my legs. The skin on my thighs and legs looks mottled, like a net pattern. Two years ago I was diagnosed with 'triple-negative' essential thrombocythemia, where the body makes too many platelets, so I take aspirin and anagrelide for it.
